values.note: RV sites $35/night plus tax (Don's Cab-Inns at Explore Park; the page carries 2026 notices). Cabins $55-95, yurts $85-130. Extended-stay specials by phone.

fees.source: https://www.roanokecountyparks.com/375 ('RV Sites ... Rates: $35/night (plus tax)'; the page's June 2026 Parkway traffic notice and 2026 GO Fest dates), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.roanokecountyparks.com/375 ('Sites are 12' by 35' and have 30 amp electrical service. No water or sewer hookup is available, but there are municipal water spigots near each site'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Dump station free for overnight guests ($15 for others); municipal water spigots near each RV site; a bathhouse near every site. Firewood and other extras can be ordered with the booking.

facilities.source: https://www.roanokecountyparks.com/375 ('A dump station is available, free for overnight guests ($15 for non-guests)', 'municipal water spigots near each site', 'all within close proximity to a bathhouse'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: RV sites are 12 x 35 ft, each with a picnic table and fire ring; no rig length is stated. Cabins and yurts share the campground; primitive tent sites are separate at Blue Ridge Campground (weekends Memorial Day-Labor Day).
On-season rates April through November, off season December through March (the RV rate is the same all year).

season.source: https://www.roanokecountyparks.com/375 ('On season rates apply April through November, and off season is December through March'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book on Roanoke County's online registration portal (account required; pick the site on an interactive map) or call the Explore Park Visitor Center at (540) 427-1800. 'Two-night minimum stay applies on Friday & Saturday nights.' Refunds if requested seven days ahead, otherwise account credit.

booking.source: https://www.roanokecountyparks.com/375 ('Register Online: By using Roanoke County's ONLINE REGISTRATION PORTAL', 'Register By Phone: Call the Explore Park Visitor Center at (540) 427-1800', RV Sites: 'Two-night minimum stay applies on Friday & Saturday nights'), read 2026-10-21

note: Roanoke County park at Blue Ridge Parkway MP 115; the campground (cabins, yurts and RV sites) is operated by Don's Cab-Inns, booked through Roanoke County's online portal or the visitor center. RV sites are 12 x 35 ft with 30-amp electric only (no water/sewer at the site; water spigots nearby, dump station free for guests). Two-night minimum on Friday and Saturday nights. RV area is up by the visitor center, not on the Roanoke River. --Claude
summary: County page (2026): RV sites $35/night plus tax, 30-amp electric, no water or sewer at the site, spigots nearby, free dump for guests, open all year, two-night Friday/Saturday minimum, booked on the county portal or by phone. Changed electric 50 -> 30 (derived value from the note; the note corrected to match). Not stated: site count, showers, max rig length (pads are 12 x 35 ft).
